Independent-review host results are admitted only through an opaque host_result_ref whose signed envelope verifies against an immutable release-pinned provider key. The supported provider envelope binds issuer, producer, channel, stable workspace identity, audience, operation, assignment/proof-subject revisions, nonce, expiry, and key revision. Repo-local files, user-home trust stores, PYTHONPATH modules, environment variables, operation arguments, caller-installed runtime keys, and caller-supplied verifier keys/signatures are non-authoritative caches.

Independent-review receipts are bound to changed scope and fail closed when the provider envelope expires, revokes, supersedes, reuses a nonce for a distinct result, or no longer verifies against the current release-pinned key at import and proof-use time.
